newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pengkalen Hldgs, Pengkalen Capital shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Pengkalen Hldgs, Pengkalen Capital shrs suspended.

text.p: Shares of Pengkalen Holdings Bhd and its unit Pengkalen Capital Bhd were suspended on Thursday at the companies' requests, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
Officials at Pengkalen Holdings were not available for comment. The companies are part of the same group.
Diversified Pengkalen Holdings is involved in financial, food, property and leisure sectors. Its stock closed at 5.60 ringgit on Wednesday.
Pengkalen Capital, whose stock closed at 6.65 ringgit on Wednesday, is 51.5 percent owned by Pengkalen Holdings. It operates two stockbroking companies.
